details.value: Global Education Limited has given Intimation regarding opening of the Buy-back Offer of Equity Shares of Global Education Limited through the Tender Offer route with effect from November 23, 2026.

details.label: Voice Summary
details.value: Global Education Limited has opened its buy-back offer for up to 14,75,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 2 each. The buy-back price is Rs. 162 per share, with an aggregate consideration not exceeding Rs. 23,89,50,000. The offer was approved by the Board on September 24, 2026, and by shareholders via postal ballot, with results declared on October 28, 2026. The buy-back opens on Monday, November 23, 2026, and closes on Monday, November 30, 2026. The record date for eligibility was Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Eligible shareholders holding shares as of the record date may tender their shares through stock brokers. The offer is conducted through the tender offer route via the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Kreo Capital Private Limited is the manager, and Bigshare Services Private Limited is the registrar.

details.label: Attchmnt Text
details.value: Dalmia Bharat Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 23, 2026, inter-alia approving buyback of equity shares

details.label: Voice Summary
details.value: Dalmia Bharat Limited board approved a buyback of up to 37,83,783 equity shares at a maximum price of INR 1,850 per share. The total buyback size is capped at INR 700,00,00,000. This represents approximately 2.02% of the paid-up equity share capital. The buyback excludes promoters and persons in control. Funds will be deployed via the open market route through BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The company must utilize at least INR 525,00,00,000 for the buyback. At least 40% of the maximum size, amounting to INR 280,00,00,000, must be spent within the initial 66 working days. Mr. Rajeev Kumar is appointed as the Compliance Officer for this transaction. A public announcement detailing the process and timelines will be released within two working days from the board resolution date.

details.value: TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 23, 2026, titled "Titagarh Rail Systems bags new order from JSW for 181 BFNSM1 wagons and 3 BVCM wagons; Gets approval to manufacture auto carrier wagons expanding its product offering".

details.label: Exchange field · Voice Summary
details.value: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited has received an order from JSW South Rail Logistics for INR 77.09 crore for 181 BFNSM1 wagons and 3 BVCM wagons. The company also obtained route clearance from Indian Railways to manufacture and dispatch specialized auto carrier wagons. This approval connects the Bharatpur Manufacturing Unit to the DFCCIL network. Titagarh is now one of the few manufacturers capable of producing all types of freight wagons. The company is developing a prototype auto carrier wagon to offer shorter delivery timelines. Vice Chairman Umesh Chowdhary stated this expands the product portfolio and supports the national target of 3,000 MT freight loading by 2027. The announcement was filed on 23rd November 2026.
